content.visible_text: Skip to Content About Schedule Youth Program FAQs Contact AUthentic muay thai in the heart of san francisco more than a gym. a community. Try a Class No experience necessary. All levels welcome! Our experienced coaches have over 25 years of teaching , working with everyone from first-timers to pro fighters. We train together, grow together, and push for progress inside and out. View Schedule Certified by the thai boxing association of america Try a Class reviews "You're not going to find a better combo of genuine and approachable dudes who are also skilled, passionate and attentive fight coaches like you will in Dave and Joe." Joshua Brain J. San Francisco, CA "This gym is great because you get lots of individual attention, even in the classes, and the environment is really welcoming and friendly no matter your skill level. " Ariel J. Chicago, IL “I started practicing Muay Thai a little over a year ago under Dave's instruction, and I couldn't have asked for a better mentor as a complete beginner." Moon D. San Francisco, CA "Joe and Dave are extremely well-rounded teachers and their relatively small class sizes compared to other gyms allows them to give attention to students individually." Eric T. San Francisco, CA "I highly recommend this place! It's refueled my passion for martial arts and I couldn't be happier to have found an incredible gym community." Samantha A. San Francisco, CA "They'll make sure you learn and work out hard, but they also stress timing and technique so you learn the right way." Nikky L. Washington, DC "There are so many great things to say about CMA. All the coaches are incredibly knowledgeable and push you without creating a hostile environment" Michael L.
